title: Confirming IME composition does not send an unfinished chat message
detail: Enter during IME composition invoked onSend in both enter and mod-enter modes. The shared composer now ignores composing keydown and Safari IME keyCode 229. Both mode regressions failed before the fix and pass after. The backlog probe executes the actual pure helper or component handlers with isolated dependencies, without launching a nested test runner. Full behavioral Vitest suites remain independently required by CI.
